Hi,

It’s incredible how many Citizens for Prosperity locations have started to thrive throughout the system. To sustain these locations, we need to be able to move important supplies between them. Got one such important run here, if you’re interested.  

There’s a few boxes of goods waiting at [Location] that need to cross the system to [Destination]. Could you move them for us and help us all build a better future?

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
